theorem phsWit_of_hsWit [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (h : HardStateM) (n : Nat) : hsWit
    γ h n ⊢ phsWit γ h

theorem hsWit_of_phsWit [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (h : HardStateM) (n : Nat) (Hn :
    ↑n ≤ uint.Z h.Commit') : phsWit γ h ⊢ hsWit γ h n

def phsWit [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (h : HardStateM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜h = { Term' := W64 0, Vote' := W64 0, Commit' := W64 0 }⌝ ∨ commitWit γ h.Term' h.Commit')

theorem hsWit_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (h : HardStateM) (n : Nat) : Timeless (hsWit γ
    h n)

theorem phsWit_zero [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : ⊢ phsWit γ { Term' := W64 0, Vote'
    := W64 0, Commit' := W64 0 }

theorem phsNext_ne (p h : HardStateM) (H : ¬(h.Term' = W64 0 ∧ h.Vote' = W64 0 ∧ h.Commit' = W64 0))
    : phsNext p h = h

def hsWit [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (h : HardStateM) (n : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜h = { Term' := W64 0, Vote' := W64 0, Commit' := W64 0 }⌝ ∨
      commitWit γ h.Term' h.Commit' ∗ ⌜↑n ≤ uint.Z h.Commit'⌝)

theorem phsNext_zero (p : HardStateM) : phsNext p { Term' := W64 0, Vote' := W64 0, Commit' := W64 0
    } = p

theorem phsNext_empty (p h : HardStateM) (H : h.Term' = W64 0 ∧ h.Vote' = W64 0 ∧ h.Commit' = W64 0)
    : phsNext p h = p

theorem ownRaftGhost_commitWit [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) {md
    : Bool} : ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md -∗ commitWit γ s.term s.commit

theorem hsWit_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (h : HardStateM) (n : Nat) : Persistent
    (hsWit γ h n)

theorem commitWit_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T c : w64) : Timeless (commitWit γ T c)

theorem phsWit_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (h : HardStateM) : Persistent (phsWit γ h)

def phsNext (p h : HardStateM) : HardStateM :=
  if h.Term' = W64 0 ∧ h.Vote' = W64 0 ∧ h.Commit' = W64 0 then p else h

def commitWit [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T c : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ F, ⌜PlogWf base0 F⌝ ∗ logRecs γ base0 F ∗ commitIn γ F c T ∗ isCommitted γ (List.take (uint.Z c).toNat F))

def hsZero : HardStateM :=
  { Term' := W64 0, Vote' := W64 0, Commit' := W64 0 }

def hardStateM_countable : Pos.Countable HardStateM :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun h => Pos.Countable.encode (h.Term', h.Vote', h.Commit')) hardStateM_countable._proof_1

theorem phsWit_of_hsWit_next [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (p h : HardStateM) (n : Nat)
    : hsWit γ (phsNext p h) n ⊢ phsWit γ h

theorem commitWit_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T c : w64) : Persistent (commitWit γ T
    c)
